scope: Additional coverage; original campaign and gates remain unchanged. Freeze before supplemental compiled execution or Wasm observation.

native.all_domain_states: Finite typed full state, SPD normalized Mandel stress, source f below ft, physical H=max(ft,f+max(q,0)) within1e-8*ft, and wp exactly zero for these elastic paths.
native.proportional_success: For each negative proportional elastic request, accepted total strain must remain strictly before analytic remaining extinction; full endpoint must remain proportional within1e-8 relative Mandel norm.
native.half_critical_accuracy: Every half-critical hydro/proportional request, including tiny initial pressures and retries: full source-reference relative Mandel error<=0.005.
native.failed_request_recovery: Every domain failure returns exact parent. Two independent identical valid requests from failed returned parent and original parent, using0.001 of parent remaining proportional lifetime, must succeed and give identical complete states.
native.successful_prefix: Reconstruct each contiguous successful proportional prefix by exact returned-parent match and identical strain/parameters; cumulative supplied proportional strain must remain strictly below root analytic critical lifetime.

wasm.original_gate: Literal API replay: exact statuses, scope/catalogue metadata, full state scaled error<=1e-8. Historical v2 failures remain separate evidence; not silently removed.
wasm.typed_finite: All compared state and strain entries must be finite numbers; null/string coercion forbidden.
wasm.lab_strain: Compare all point strain arrays with absolute error<=1e-10 when present, identical shape and metadata. Point control must be finite numeric, absolute difference<=1e-12; response integration_settings and loading/response_contract metadata must match exactly when present.
wasm.relative_stress: For v3 admissible-parent requests only, every returned stress must be SPD, f<=k1*(1+1e-10), checked after maxabs normalization. Stress difference Mandel norm divided by min(4*(trace(Snative)/(k1*(1+1e-10))),4*(trace(Swasm)/(k1*(1+1e-10))))<=1e-6. Nonpositive/nonfinite/underflowed denominator fails, no floor. Intentional non-SPD invalid parents require exact rejected-state preservation in both backends, and are excluded only from this SPD-normalized metric.
wasm.source_and_transactions: Apply same supplemental domain source tests to Wasm responses; failed states exact parent; repeated direct/retry and holds exact state. Replay supplemental recovery requests too.
wasm.self_chained_paths: Separate complete domain replay feeds each Wasm returned state into its next original contiguous external step. Status matches original study at every request; source invariants, local/cumulative event checks and halfcritical accuracy apply to actual Wasm inputs/outputs. Every chain failure has exact rollback and successful identical direct/retry recovery using0.001of its own parent lifetime.
wasm.exact_transactions: Every successful literal mechanical zero increment preserves complete raw parent exactly, including signed history aliases. Failed mechanical requests must match native rejected status and returned-state presence/absence; whenever a returned state and finite numeric parent are present, it must equal that parent exactly. Parser/preflight errors may return no state as in the unchanged native contract.

limits: This supplement adds no generic all-model legacy claim, no E5 approval, and no rigorous general3D event theorem. Model/runtime/source gates remain pinned to prospective-freeze.json.
